compositionOwner.name: BuildsHomePage
compositionOwner.responsibility: compose the seven target regions from one presentation model; no route-private visual patch for a shared owner

contract.topology: title, adjacent source chip, flexible middle, one square book action
one framed two-column surface with a fixed medallion pane and one identity/evidence pane
interactions: open specialization picker without changing the outer geometry

variants.grid: one continuous 2x2 outer frame with cross dividers and four equal tiles
variants.list: one continuous outer frame with four fixed-column rows and horizontal separators

contract.sharedInvariant: the grid and list receive the same four item objects; title, state, value, navigation, and medallion semantics cannot diverge

contract.topology: one raised gold-framed surface with medallion, status/copy column, and right primary action
one continuous three-row frame with a shared vertical rail and fixed icon/copy/status/chevron columns
interactions: input opens the first incomplete input route

contract.topology: four equal columns; active visuals never change column width or label position
contract.nativeSafeArea: background reaches the physical screen bottom and controls remain above safeArea.bottom

contract.responsibility: frame layer, content-safe inset, and owner/region metadata

rejectedReuse.reason: legacy topology is icon plus generic module cards and cannot express the target overview, workspace CTA, or evidence matrices
ranked content rows cannot express the target fixed evidence columns or workflow timeline and previously produced table-like layouts
may not own any of the five authored framed compositions; only lower-level forged frame hosting is allowed
a standalone full-page state panel would replace target geometry; state must render inside every stable owner

layoutContract.rule: H5 comparison keeps the target-scaled route content unchanged, reuses the verified shared TabBar as a 73px outer shell with 71px controls and 2px bottom continuation, and captures 780x1660 at DPR2; the inherited shared shell starts at y=757px while the target control region starts near y=759px, and this declared 2px reconciliation cannot create a route-private TabBar variant
layoutContract.nativeSafeArea: WeChat may compact only declared vertical padding and gaps to absorb status-bar and home-indicator insets; horizontal geometry, font sizes, item counts, and topology remain unchanged

stateContract.loadingRule: same owner DOM and region bounds with loading labels/assets; no blank first viewport
stateContract.degradedRule: partial/stale/blocked/error labels replace values but never remove target slots
stateContract.clippingRule: every visible Text node and action label must remain inside its owner at H5 DPR2 and WeChat native safe-area viewports
